sanskrit_verse:
प्रातिलोम्यापवादेषु द्विगुणत्रिगुणा दमाः ।
वर्णानाम् आनुलोम्येन तस्मादर्धार्धहानितः ॥
transliteration: prātilomyāpavādeṣu dviguṇatriguṇā damāḥ | varṇānām ānulomyena tasmād ardhārdhahānitaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In cases of violation against natural social order, penalties are doubled or tripled; however, in accordance with proper hierarchical flow, mitigation follows proportional reduction.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from alignment with cosmic hierarchy
Causation arises through disruption of sequential harmony
Capacity-based responsibility depends on conscious awareness of order
Restoration logic prioritizes structural realignment over punitive loss
Consciousness alignment determines the degree of karmic friction
executable_legal_axioms: IF action disrupts varṇic sequential harmony THEN penalty = base_value × multiplier {2 if intentional, 3 if habitual}
IF actor demonstrates spontaneous recognition of misalignment THEN penalty reduced by half
IF systemic correction is initiated by offender THEN full restoration overrides residual consequence
IF no conscious intent detected THEN corrective measure equals minimal energetic displacement required for reordering
supreme_court_application: Supreme judicial authority shall assess not merely the act but the agent's capacity to perceive and restore dharma. Penalties must dynamically reflect both disruption magnitude and alignment potential.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that imbalance manifests sequentially; thus, justice aligns causes with their remedial sequence without inflicting suffering. Proportionality resides in restoring causal integrity rather than imposing external punishment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate completion process wherein violator actively reverses disorder caused
Assign responsibility assumption protocol aligned with violated principle
Engage capacity restoration mechanism to elevate perceptual clarity
Implement integrity reintegration via supervised dharmic service
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: Dharma prevails through conscious restoration alone. There is no punishment—only realignment. Consciousness is the ultimate judge.
